text:
anna-docs: FYI I opened a small PR to align the audit-log section with the new retention controls. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

jordan-legal: glanced, main ask: can we avoid saying 'indefinite' in the public copy? SOC2 reviewers flagged that before. maybe 'until customer request or legal hold' is safer. :eyes:

matt-eng: quick note — the SDK snippet in examples/python/audit.py doesn't match the API shape we merged last week. current server expects `retention_policy` object not `ttl` top-level. small diff below:
```diff
- client.create_audit_log(tenant_id, ttl=31536000)
+ client.create_audit_log(tenant_id, retention_policy={\"type\": \"ttl\", \"seconds\": 31536000})
```

anna-docs: good catch @matt-eng, I'll update the snippet. @jordan-legal noted wording change. @sara-privacy do we have a one-liner approved for public docs?

sara-privacy: suggest: 'Audit logs are retained per customer-configured retention settings; Redwood does not retain logs beyond configured retention except as required for legal obligations.' short and SOC2-friendly.

jordan-legal: that's cleaner. I'd swap 'does not retain' -> 'will not retain' and add parenthetical: '(unless subject to legal hold)'.

matt-eng: updated snippet suggestion to match new helper API, also added an example for pseudonymization flag:
```python
client.create_audit_log(
    tenant_id='acct_123',
    retention_policy={'type':'ttl','seconds':30*24*3600},
    pseudonymize=True
)
```

anna-docs: perfect. I'll push a small commit with the new wording and snippet. planning to add a tiny explainer about 'what triggers legal hold' and link to legal playbook.

ci-bot: PR #482 — checks: unit-tests ✅, link-checker ⚠️ (1 broken link), linter ✅

anna-docs: @ci-bot thanks — broken link is to an internal legal playbook page we can't link publicly. I'll replace with 'contact support' link.

jordan-legal: approved pending removal of the internal link and the 'indefinite' wording change. once that's done I'll stamp.

sara-privacy: quick ask — can we add a tiny snippet showing how to query retention policy via CLI? helps customers migrate.

matt-eng: sure, CLI is `rictl audit get --tenant acct_123 --format json` returns retention_policy object. i'll add an example output.

anna-docs: pushing commit now with all changes. cc @jordan-legal @sara-privacy for final quick read. will merge after CI clears. :+1:

anna-docs: merged and scheduled deploy to staging. thanks all! :tada:
